set.smtpGmailStep1: Pịa Jiri Gmail n'okpuru - onye ọbịa, ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri 587, na TLS jupụtara na akpaghị aka.
set.smtpGmailStep2: Tinye Gmail gị n'uju site na email na aha njirimara (dịka you@gmail.com).
set.smtpGmailStep3: Gbanwuo nkwenye 2-nzọụkwụ na Akaụntụ Google gị, wee mepụta paswọọdụ ngwa. Jiri paswọọdụ ebe a - ọ bụghị paswọọdụ Gmail gị nkịtị.

set.smtpPasswordKeep: Hapụ oghere ka ọ dị adị
set.smtpReadyBody: Ozi ịntanetị ga-eziga site na nkesa a mgbe ị na-eji Zipụ Email. Gbanwee mgbakwunye PDF na ndebiri email.
set.smtpWebStep1: Pịa Jiri Webmail n'okpuru - Hostinger defaults jupụta na-akpaghị aka (smtp.hostinger.com, ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri 465, SSL). Gbanwee onye nnabata ma ọ bụrụ na ijiri onye na-eweta ọzọ.
set.smtpWebStep2: Bochum: debe ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri 465 na TLS gbanyụọ (SSL). Maka ndị na-eweta ndị ọzọ, ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri 587 + Jiri TLS bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị.
set.smtpWebStep3: Dejupụta Site email, Site na aha, aha njirimara (ime email zuru oke), na paswọọdụ igbe ozi.
set.smtpWebStep4: Pịa Chekwa n'elu ibe a, wee zipu email akwụkwọ nyocha.
set.smtpWebmailHint: Ihe atụ Bochum: smtp.hostinger.com · ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri 465 · SSL
